correctness.rationale: Exactly computed finite-volume variance and third cumulant give explicit long-run coefficients. Strictly positive 2x2 transfer matrix has an analytic Perron eigenvalue and strict spectral decay away from lattice frequencies; stationary spectral prefactor has zero first derivative. Arbitrarily high-order local Edgeworth inversion plus Euler--Maclaurin yields the necessary relative central CDF approximation, with explicit half-cell correction. Monotone quadratic quantile coupling produces a width-squared term and shift-squared term; Chernoff and fourth-moment estimates control tails. The 97 deterministic checks reproduce exact finite-volume moment identities and numerical transport constants. Fixed parameters are essential.
